column2: #915 initial recovery commit discovery review. Standards P0-P4=0/1/0/0/0: hard kill could land after install rename but before IaBackupDir write; the R3 driver also killed without first proving the pointer was durable. Spec P0-P4=0/0/0/1/0: the approved recovery actions were implemented as Yes/No instead of action-labelled buttons. The ticket did not define the pointer-write interval as a separate AC. Both findings were fixed by 26af1d67; the later 38794859..26af1d67 review passed both axes with zero findings, and real Windows R3 evidence is on issue #915.
